baseline_findings.statement: R611Q is associated with reduced TSC1 binding, TSC-complex formation, or complex-associated TSC1 abundance in the reported engineered systems.
limitations: Several later sources measure TSC1 or TSC2 signal rather than physical binding.
Repeated use of the same constructs, comparator allele, or assay lineage is not independent replication.
The systems are engineered overexpression or re-expression models, not endogenous heterozygous patient cells.

baseline_findings.statement: R611Q has lower steady-state TSC2 abundance in multiple assay formats, including an independent VAMP-seq measurement.
limitations: Steady-state abundance is not a direct measurement of folding, half-life, or degradation route.
VAMP-seq measures a GFP-fusion abundance phenotype.
The external laboratory used an R611Q plasmid supplied from the Nellist reagent lineage.

baseline_findings.statement: R611Q remains susceptible to Pam/MYCBP2-associated ubiquitination despite TSC1 co-expression in one direct HEK293T experiment.
limitations: The direct R611Q ubiquitination result is from one laboratory and one engineered system.
The experiment did not measure R611Q-specific half-life, proteasome-dependent abundance rescue, a degron, or misfolding.
HERC1 and Hsp90 sources describe general TSC2 proteostasis and did not test R611Q.

baseline_findings.statement: R611Q impairs TSC-complex-dependent suppression of mTORC1 readouts in several low-throughput assays.
limitations: Most low-throughput support shares assay and reagent ancestry.
The same cliPE score is indeterminate under the 2024 thresholds and abnormal under the 2026 cutoff.
Downstream phospho-S6K or phospho-S6 changes do not isolate complex formation, abundance, or intrinsic GAP activity.

baseline_findings.statement: Wild-type experimental TSC-complex coordinates include TSC2 residue 611, providing a structural baseline but not an R611Q structure.
limitations: Neither structure contains the R611Q mutant.
Residue inclusion does not establish local side-chain density, a defined TSC1 contact, ligandability, or a mutant-created pocket.
Local map quality, chain numbering, construct boundaries, alternate conformers, and assembly assumptions require explicit assessment.

unsupported_or_not_measured.statement: R611Q directly misfolds, aggregates, or exposes a hydrophobic patch.
R611Q has a shortened half-life or demonstrated proteasome-dependent turnover.
R611Q creates or exposes a defined degron.
R611Q retains intrinsic Rheb-GAP activity after abundance and complex formation are restored.
R611Q has a validated ligandable pocket or a defined Arg611-TSC1 contact.
A compound directly binds, stabilizes, or rescues R611Q TSC2.

mechanism_decision.rationale: The corpus supports impaired complex behavior and lower steady-state abundance, with one direct ubiquitination result, but does not determine whether the primary remediable defect is local instability, interface disruption, distal allostery, or no structurally addressable route.
